title: RLCG Transmission Line
text: Model RLCG transmission line, {Interpolation method} sets Method to interpolate network parameters; {Resistance per length (ohms/m)} sets the resistance of RLGC transmission lines, {Inductance per length (H/m)} sets the inductance of RLGC transmission lines, {Capacitance per length (F/m)} sets the capacitance of RLGC transmission lines, {Conductance per length(S/m)} sets the conductance of RLGC transmission lines, {Frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency at which RLGC transmission line operate, {Transmission line length (m)} sets the physical length of transmission line, {Stub mode} sets the type of stub Not, {Termination of stub} sets the stub termination, {Source of frequency data} sets the frequency data source, {Frequency data (Hz)} sets the frequency data range, {Reference impedance (ohms)}, {Plot type} sets the type of data plot, {Y parameter1} sets the type of parameters, {Y parameter2} sets the type of parameters, {Y format1} plots format Magnitude, {Y format2} plots format Magnitude, {X parameter} sets the frequency plot, {X format} sets the frequency plot format, {Y scale} sets the y-axis scale, {X scale} sets the x-axis scale and {Plot}. Values come from the instance.
